newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron rises 5.71 pct on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Petron rises 5.71 pct on bargain hunting.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp gained 40 centavos, or 5.71 percent, to 7.40 pesos in late trading as investors picked up the shares after they went ex-dividend, brokers said.
"Some investors sold their holdings before it went ex-dividend, and bought them back after the price adjustment," one analyst at a local securities firm said.
Petron was one of the most heavily traded stocks on Wednesday.
Petron went ex-dividend on May 13 for its 20 percent stock dividend to be given to shareholders as of May 21.
